title: API Proposal: transfer result, change, search events from the helper to instantsearch.js

comments.body: Yes, that would totally help my use case and more complex ones. :+1:

> Why about proposing some sort higher order widgets? Decorator?

Yes it works for this use case indeed. Wonder what's the best choice. Can you think of other high order widgets?
Anything that could require some events of the helper in a widget context could be factorize in those. But no I don't see other case here ;)
`showWhenNoResults`, could be done to implement the list of current refinement of the instant search demo.
Closing this, will open a new one when really needed
